task_instance: Provision Neon Auth (Managed Better Auth) for a new app: enable auth:true in neon.ts, run `neon deploy`/`neon neon-auth enable`, and implement+verify a basic sign-up/sign-in flow using @neondatabase/auth against the provisioned neon_auth schema.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires a real Neon account and an existing (or newly created) Neon project on AWS, authenticated via the `neon` CLI or API, in order to run `neon neon-auth enable` / `neon deploy` and provision the managed `neon_auth` schema, Auth URL, and JWKS endpoint. This is an account-bound, credentialed cloud service (Neon project + API key/CLI login). The sandbox rules forbid using or searching for credentials/tokens and forbid account-bound or paid services, so I cannot create/authenticate a Neon project. The `neon` CLI is also not installed in this runtime, and installing it would not help without real Neon credentials to authenticate against. Faking the Better Auth client locally without a live Neon-provisioned neon_auth schema would not exercise the skill's actual stated deliverable (managed identity in Postgres, auth emails via shared SMTP, branch-scoped Auth URLs, etc.), so no meaningful workaround was attempted.
